name: gl-split-slide-in-vertical
title: SplitSlideInVertical transition
description: The incoming image slides in as two halves moving vertically in opposite directions. Load vendor/glintmotion/hyper-shader.js, then this file, then call HyperShader.init({ transitions: [{ time, shader: "gl-split-slide-in-vertical", duration }] }).
